# Rubric

## Summary
Reusable grading grid of Rubric Criteria; `totalPoints` computed.

## Usage
`linksTo(() => Rubric)` from Assignment; read by Rubric Grader and Grade Submission.

## Non-goals
No per-learner data.

## Example
The linked example grades an analytics report on several weighted criteria, each with its own ladder of levels.
attributes.cardDescription: A reusable grading grid of weighted criteria with scored levels; its total points are computed.
